about: One place draws its lights from ONE bucket, so its fire reads as one place. Mixing fixtures inside a bucket is wanted (a tomb has candles in niches, a cluster by the dead, a brazier in the great hall); mixing buckets is what reads wrong (a street lamp-post in a barrow). A dressing plan names its bucket with "lights": "<bucket>"; `dress check` warns about a light from outside it, and about a plan whose lights fit no single bucket. A project may replace this file with authoring/light-buckets.json.

tomb.for: barrows, crypts, chapels, shrines, anything of the dead
tomb.note: candles carry it: niches, ledges, round the dead, on the altar. A brazier only in a great hall or before the boss.

manor.for: manors, halls, houses, taverns, a haunted house
manor.note: chandeliers and hearths in the big rooms, a brazier corner in a hall, sconces along passages, candles and low candelabra on furniture (not fixtures/lamp-lit: its lit glass reads as a white bust at room distance, owner 2026-10-29); window-daylight on the window anchors (day only).

delve.note: what someone carried in: torches, lanterns, a fire where they camp.

camp.for: camps, landings, ruins someone is living in
camp.note: one fire at the heart (camp-props/bonfire for giants, ogres or any big camp), torches or lanterns at the edge.

street.note: the town's own fittings. Streets, plazas, gates, quays and the roads out are lit by tools/town-lights.mts (tools/street-lights.json), not by hand.

rime.for: ice halls, glacier galleries, frozen tombs (blue-white cold light)
rime.note: cold blue-white glow carries it: lanterns and glows tinted ice-blue (#b8d0ff) in niches and along the galleries; ONE fire, the bonfire in a hearth hall where the living gather. Detail pass: cold-tinted variants of lantern-glow / hanging-lantern.

lych-span.for: the Lych Span: a road bridge with a gate tower, lit at night by its own lamp posts and gate lanterns (warm, the house street-lamp range)
lych-span.note: lamp posts on the pier refuges, one hanging lantern at each deck end; nothing else burns on the deck. Lights come from the prefabs (fixtures/looks/street-lamp-glow: 11 / range 10), no extra lights.
